title: Upcoming Webinar: Breaking the Maintenance Cycle with Lined Sanitary Sewer Solutions 12/3/26
body_markdown:
#### Breaking the Maintenance Cycle: Lined Sanitary Sewer Solutions for Permanent Corrosion Protection & Rehabilitation


###### Thursday, December 3, 2026 | 12:00 P.M. – 1:00 P.M. CT


Microbiologically influenced concrete corrosion (MICC) presents a persistent challenge for sanitary sewer infrastructure, leading to structural deterioration, costly repairs, and recurring maintenance. Conventional approaches, such as field-applied coatings, provide temporary protection, but require periodic reapplication and ongoing investment.


This webinar explores how corrosion-resistant lined technologies by NWPX offer long-term solutions for both new construction and the structural rehabilitation of existing wastewater infrastructure. Learn how these systems provide lasting corrosion protection, reduce lifecycle maintenance demands, and support more cost-effective asset management.


###### Topics Covered:


- Understanding Microbiologically Influenced Concrete Corrosion (MICC)
- Overview of Conventional Corrosion Protection and Rehabilitation Methods
- Lined Sanitary Sewer Solutions for New Construction and Comparison to Traditional methods for Corrosion Protection
- Rehabilitation of Manholes and Large Wastewater Structures with Permanent Solutions
- Project Examples and Custom Solutions
- Q&A


**Earn up to 1 PDH / CEU credit for attending (check with your local licensing agency for eligibility. A certificate of completion will be provided after the webinar).**
